name: f1_strategy_pipeline
description: PitMind Langflow Pipeline with 6 Nodes: Fetch -> Context -> Docling -> MCP -> Granite -> Route

data.label: OpenF1Fetcher
data.description: HTTP GET to OpenF1 API (/v1/laps, /v1/stints, etc). Output: typed dict of current race state.

data.label: HistoricalContext
data.description: Query Ergast API for historical pit stop patterns + tyre degradation rates.

data.label: DoclingIngestor
data.description: Parse uploaded race strategy PDFs using Docling. Output: structured text chunks with page references.

data.label: ContextForgeBuilder
data.description: Assemble MCP (Model Context Protocol) block using ContextForge API. MUST use proper MCP spec, not just string concatenation. Inject as structured system context.

data.label: GraniteInference
data.description: Call Granite with assembled context + user query. Enforce JSON schema via prompt.

data.label: OutputRouter
data.description: Parse JSON response -> route to UI websockets/REST.
